name: Adriana Calcanhotto (Sold Out)
description: A quick note for fans: the celebrated Brazilian singer-songwriter's "Voice and Guitar" concert for next Tuesday at Sala Suggia is completely sold out.
longDescription:
Adriana Calcanhotto, the acclaimed Brazilian singer-songwriter, was scheduled to perform her "Voz e Guitarra" (Voice and Guitar) concert at Casa da Música. Known for her poetic lyrics and distinctive vocal style, Calcanhotto has built a significant career spanning decades, blending bossa nova, pop, and MPB (Música Popular Brasileira). This performance was set to showcase her artistry in an intimate, stripped-down format, focusing on her voice and acoustic guitar.

Attendees would have experienced an evening of refined musicality within the grand setting of Casa da Música's Sala Suggia. The concert was designed to be a contemplative and engaging experience, appealing to fans of Brazilian music and those appreciative of sophisticated songwriting. The atmosphere would have been focused and appreciative, allowing the audience to connect directly with Calcanhotto's nuanced performance.

This event, scheduled for October 27, 2026, at Casa da Música, is completely sold out. Tickets were in high demand and quickly became unavailable. Casa da Música is located in Boavista and is accessible via the Casa da Música metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F), which is directly adjacent to the venue.
